newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua seeks to roll back 1993 sugar mill sale.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua seeks to roll back 1993 sugar mill sale.

text.p: Nicaragua's Attorney General's Office has asked a judge to annul the 1993 privatization of the country's largest sugar mill.

Attorney General Julio Centeno late on Friday asked a local judge in a written statement to overturn the sale of the Victoria de Julio sugar mill, donated to Nicaragua by Cuba during the left-wing Sandinista regime in the 1980s.

The government of President Arnoldo Aleman has said former President Violeta Chamorro sold the mill to Agroindustrial Azucarera (Agroinsa) at below cost. Agroinsa is a private consortium made up of Sandinista industrialists.

For its part, Agroinsa issued a statement on Thursday telling the government to stop its threats of confiscation. It said it paid the right price for the mill, which it said had been valued by Price Waterhouse at the time.
